title: Application of securities law.
bodyText: All of the provisions of chapter 485A that are not in conflict with this chapter shall apply to any take-over offer involving a target company in this State.
bodyHtml: §417E-11  Application of securities law.  All of the provisions of chapter 485A that are not in conflict with this chapter shall apply to any take-over offer involving a target company in this State. [L 1985, c 32, pt of §2; am L 2006, c 229, §12]
